name: Le Méridien Bali Jimbaran
positioning: Le Méridien Bali Jimbaran: a resort near the beach in Jimbaran, Bali, with a large outdoor lagoon-style pool, lagoon-access rooms, a private-pool penthouse and villas, and Sky Bar overlooking Jimbaran Bay
best_for: Pool lovers who want a lagoon pool with swim-up bar and rooms with lagoon access
Couples looking for suites with deep soaking tubs, or a penthouse or villa with a private pool
Families who want a kids club close to Bali's airport

facts.text: The resort is in Jimbaran, Bali, and is situated near the beach.
The resort is a short drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport and from attractions like Garuda Wisnu Kencana Culture Park.
Rooms have balconies with ocean, lagoon or garden views.
Suites with deep soaking tubs and lagoon views make the hotel well suited to romantic getaways.
The lagoon pool has a swim-up pool bar for cocktails.
The Family Kids Club offers children arts and crafts, interactive games and outdoor adventures.
The Bale Banjar ballroom has 360-degree glass windows and ocean views.
The hotel is Green Key certified.
Self parking on site is complimentary for guests.

highlights.text: The resort has a large outdoor lagoon-style pool.
The Aqua Pool Sky Penthouse and the villas each have a private pool.
Some rooms and suites offer lagoon access.
Explore Spa offers Bali spa massages, facials and body wraps, many using plant-based ingredients.
Sky Bar serves handcrafted cocktails with panoramic views of Jimbaran Bay and its sunsets.

considerations.text: The official site describes the resort as situated near the beach.
Balcony views vary by room, between ocean, lagoon and garden.
